title: Eating Ability
description: Eating Ability transforms Minecraft survival by giving players unique powers and abilities when consuming different items.
body:
What if every item you ate gave you a unique power?

Eating Ability transforms Minecraft into a chaotic survival experience where consuming unusual items unlocks special abilities, effects, and interactions. From teleportation to explosions, every item can completely change the way you play.

**Features**
Unique abilities tied to specific items
Balanced survival-friendly gameplay
Custom advancement-based detection system
Lightweight and multiplayer compatible
Clean and optimized stable build

**Included Abilities**

- TNT → Explosive powers
- Gunpowder → Dangerous boosts
- Pickaxes → Mining abilities
- Ender Pearl → Teleportation effects
- Eye of Ender / End Crystal → End-based powers
- Furnace / Blast Furnace → Heat abilities
- Emerald → Villager-style effects
- Beds → Sleep-related mechanics
- Swords → Combat boosts
- Redstone → speed and haste
- Slime Ball → hump and slow falling
- Lightning Rod → random lightning stikes
- Soul Sand → speed
- Bell → highlights nearby entities
- Amethyst Shard
- Clock → skips time
- more soon

**Group Systems**

Entire block categories now share special mechanics:

- Logs
- Planks
- Leaves
- Ores
- Ice Blocks

Designed to work smoothly in multiplayer worlds and servers. Perfect for challenge runs, SMPs, and chaotic minigames with friends.

**Installation**
Download the datapack
Place it inside your world's datapacks folder
Run /reload
Start eating everything you probably shouldn’t.

Recommended

Best experienced on a fresh survival world with friends for maximum chaos and discovery.

Made for players who love unpredictable gameplay, overpowered abilities, and experimental survival mechanics.
